modalLead: Appearance and Behavior open straight on their settings again, in tabs, with a live preview of your dashboard beside Appearance.

items.text: Settings in tabs, no tiles first. Appearance and Behavior open straight on their settings, on the tab you used last.
Tabs grouped by what you look for. Appearance: Look, Grid, Rows, Header, Action bar, Date & weather. Behavior: General, Keyboard & search, Inbox & Fresh, Status & alerts, Privacy & sync.
A live preview beside Appearance. A small drawing of your dashboard follows every change and marks the part the open tab is about.
Every setting says what it does in a short line under it, and the filter names the other tabs where it finds something.
Make your own theme stays open. A setting tip no longer pulls you back to Look a moment later.
